chat.subtitle: Quick answers from our store info
chat.greeting: Hello! I'm the Bayariq helper, and I answer from our store info. Pick a question or type your own, like: Do you have milk?
chat.menu: What else can I help you with?
chat.thanks: You're welcome! Can I help with anything else?
chat.unknown: Sorry, I didn't understand that. Pick a topic, or try asking in other words.
chat.branchList: We have {count} branches in Jeddah. Pick one and I'll tell you where it is:
chat.hoursComingSoon: The opening hours of the {branch} are coming soon.
chat.addressComingSoon: The address of the {branch} is coming soon.
chat.noDelivery: The {branch} does not deliver at the moment. You can pick up your order from the branch.
chat.deliveryComingSoon: Delivery details for the {branch} are coming soon.
chat.contactComingSoon: The contact numbers of the {branch} are coming soon.
orderSteps: Add the products you want to the cart.
Open the cart, choose your branch, and fill in your name and order type.
Press “{send}” to send your order to the branch.
